entities.name: Yenai
entities.description: An old, scarred merfolk loremaster from Sea Gate who refused to join Gideon's forces and led merfolk remnants toward Murasa.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A character who tried to convince Yenai's band to return to Sea Gate; her sister Turi stayed with Yenai.

entities.name: Turi
entities.description: Kiora's sister, who stayed with Yenai's band.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Leader of the forces at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: Merfolk city that fell to the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: Region where Yenai hoped to find shelter.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi that was headed for Sea Gate.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: A Trickster god whose stories Kiora told to antagonize Yenai.

events.summary: When Sea Gate falls to the Eldrazi, Yenai takes his merfolk remnants, including Turi, and swims toward Murasa.
events.quote: When that too fell to the Eldrazi , Yenai took his merfolk remnants, including Kiora 's sister Turi , and swam away

events.summary: Kiora tries to persuade them to return to Sea Gate but they refuse, even her sister.
events.quote: Kiora tried to convince them to join her in going back to Sea Gate

events.summary: Kiora takes a few recruits and swims off, leaving a woman to look after her sister.
events.quote: took the few recruits, Shen , Yesha , Tola , Inash , and Runari
